+//! #104: explain a Top below remaining stock without changing the rapid/post laws.
+//! Gate map (#104): covers camcraft_app::operation::top_stock, camcraft_app::operation::generate.
+//! Provenance: original synthetic fixtures and the shop rule never to rapid into uncut stock.
+
+use camcraft_app::commands::{
+    AddTool, CreateOperation, GenerateOperation, History, ImportModel, ReorderOperation, SetStock,
+};
+use camcraft_app::geometry::{Point3, cube};
+use camcraft_app::machining2d::{Lead, Side};
+use camcraft_app::model;
+use camcraft_app::operation::{Height, OpParams, SrcRef};
+use camcraft_app::stock::StockShape;
+use camcraft_app::tools::catalog;
+use camcraft_app::verify::Warning;
+use flecs_ecs::prelude::World;
+
+fn scene(stock_top: f64, face: Option<f64>) -> World {
+    let world = camcraft_app::world::new_world();
+    let mut history = History::default();
+    history.execute(
+        &world,
+        SetStock::new(
+            &world,
+            StockShape::Box {
+                dx: 40.0,
+                dy: 40.0,
+                dz: stock_top,
+            },
+            Default::default(),
+        )
+        .expect("stock"),
+    );
+    let (_, tool) = catalog()
+        .into_iter()
+        .find(|(n, _)| *n == "EM-0600-4FL")
+        .expect("catalog");
+    history.execute(&world, AddTool::new(&world, "mill", tool).expect("tool"));
+    history.execute(
+        &world,
+        ImportModel::from_mesh("part", cube(Point3::ZERO, Point3::new(10.0, 10.0, 5.0))),
+    );
+    if let Some(cut) = face {
+        let params = OpParams::Face {
+            holes: Default::default(),
+            blend_turns: false,
+            tilt: None,
+            stepover: 4.0,
+            clearance_z: Height::fixed(20.0),
+            cut_z: Height::fixed(cut),
+            top_z: None,
+            stepdown: None,
+            feed: 1200.0,
+            plunge_feed: 300.0,
+            climb: true,
+        };
+        history.execute(
+            &world,
+            CreateOperation::new(&world, "Op1Face", "mill", SrcRef::Stock, params).expect("face"),
+        );
+        history.execute(
+            &world,
+            GenerateOperation::new(&world, "Op1Face").expect("face generation"),
+        );
+    }
+    let params = OpParams::Contour {
+        tilt: None,
+        stock_to_leave: 0.0,
+        clearance_z: Height::fixed(20.0),
+        retract_z: Height::fixed(12.0),
+        top_z: Height::fixed(5.0),
+        bottom_z: Height::fixed(0.0),
+        stepdown: 2.5,
+        feed: 800.0,
+        plunge_feed: 200.0,
+        climb: true,
+        side: Side::Auto,
+        lead: Lead::None,
+        tolerance: 0.01,
+        tab_count: 0,
+        tab_width: 0.0,
+        tab_height: 0.0,
+        entry: camcraft_app::machining3d::Entry3D::Plunge,
+        helix_radius: 1.0,
+        blend_turns: false,
+        links: camcraft_app::links::Links::PLANAR,
+    };
+    history.execute(
+        &world,
+        CreateOperation::new(
+            &world,
+            "Op2Contour",
+            "mill",
+            SrcRef::Entity("part".into()),
+            params,
+        )
+        .expect("contour"),
+    );
+    history.execute(
+        &world,
+        GenerateOperation::new(&world, "Op2Contour").expect("contour generation"),
+    );
+    world
+}
+
+fn cache(world: &World) -> camcraft_app::schema::Toolpath {
+    let e = model::find_by_name(world, "Op2Contour").expect("op");
+    model::toolpath_of(world, &e).expect("path")
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn generation_names_top_below_stock_and_keeps_the_rapid_gate() {
+    let world = scene(10.0, None);
+    let tp = cache(&world);
+    let note = tp
+        .path
+        .notes
+        .iter()
+        .find(|n| n.starts_with("Top below stock:"));
+    assert!(note.is_some(), "missing the cause: {:?}", tp.path.notes);
+    let note = note.expect("warning");
+    for text in [
+        "Z5.000",
+        "Z10.000",
+        "over its region",
+        "raise Top or face first",
+    ] {
+        assert!(note.contains(text), "{note}");
+    }
+    assert!(
+        tp.warnings
+            .iter()
+            .any(|w| matches!(w, Warning::RapidInStock { .. }))
+    );
+    let out = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("camcraft-top-stock-{}.nc", std::process::id()));
+    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&out);
+    assert!(camcraft_app::posting::post_setup(&world, &out).is_err());
+    assert!(!out.exists(), "the unsafe program must write nothing");
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn facing_to_top_removes_the_height_warning_but_a_shallow_face_does_not() {
+    let cleared = cache(&scene(10.0, Some(5.0)));
+    assert!(
+        cleared
+            .path
+            .notes
+            .iter()
+            .all(|n| !n.starts_with("Top below stock:")),
+        "{:?}",
+        cleared.path.notes
+    );
+    assert!(cleared.warnings.is_empty(), "{:?}", cleared.warnings);
+    let partial = cache(&scene(10.0, Some(8.0)));
+    assert!(
+        partial
+            .path
+            .notes
+            .iter()
+            .any(|n| n.contains("Top below stock:") && n.contains("Z8.000")),
+        "{:?}",
+        partial.path.notes
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn top_at_the_stock_surface_has_no_height_warning() {
+    let tp = cache(&scene(5.0, None));
+    assert!(
+        tp.path
+            .notes
+            .iter()
+            .all(|n| !n.starts_with("Top below stock:")),
+        "{:?}",
+        tp.path.notes
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn a_narrow_mesh_stock_feature_is_not_acquitted_by_an_unsampled_prior() {
+    let world = scene(10.0, None);
+    let mut history = History::default();
+    let mut raw = cube(Point3::new(-20.0, -20.0, 0.0), Point3::new(20.0, 20.0, 5.0))
+        .facets
+        .to_vec();
+    raw.extend(
+        cube(
+            Point3::new(1.001, 1.001, 5.0),
+            Point3::new(1.006, 1.006, 10.0),
+        )
+        .facets
+        .iter()
+        .copied(),
+    );
+    history.execute(
+        &world,
+        ImportModel::from_mesh("raw-stock", camcraft_app::geometry::Mesh::from_facets(raw)),
+    );
+    history.execute(
+        &world,
+        SetStock::new(
+            &world,
+            StockShape::FromModel {
+                source: "raw-stock".into(),
+            },
+            Default::default(),
+        )
+        .expect("mesh stock"),
+    );
+    history.execute(
+        &world,
+        ImportModel::from_mesh(
+            "remote-patch",
+            cube(Point3::new(12.0, 12.0, 0.0), Point3::new(16.0, 16.0, 5.0)),
+        ),
+    );
+    let face = OpParams::Face {
+        holes: Default::default(),
+        blend_turns: false,
+        tilt: None,
+        stepover: 4.0,
+        clearance_z: Height::fixed(20.0),
+        cut_z: Height::fixed(5.0),
+        top_z: None,
+        stepdown: None,
+        feed: 1200.0,
+        plunge_feed: 300.0,
+        climb: true,
+    };
+    history.execute(
+        &world,
+        CreateOperation::new(
+            &world,
+            "Op1Elsewhere",
+            "mill",
+            SrcRef::Entity("remote-patch".into()),
+            face,
+        )
+        .expect("remote face"),
+    );
+    history.execute(
+        &world,
+        GenerateOperation::new(&world, "Op1Elsewhere").expect("generate remote face"),
+    );
+    history.execute(
+        &world,
+        ReorderOperation::new(&world, "Op1Elsewhere", "Op2Contour", false)
+            .expect("prior runs first"),
+    );
+    let prior = camcraft_app::rest::prior_plan(&world, "Op2Contour", None, 3.0)
+        .expect("plan")
+        .expect("predecessor")
+        .simulate()
+        .expect("sampled grid");
+    assert!(
+        (0..prior.nx * prior.ny).all(|k| prior.top_at(k) <= 5.0 + 1e-6),
+        "fixture must miss the narrow high feature, not credit its removal"
+    );
+    history.execute(
+        &world,
+        GenerateOperation::new(&world, "Op2Contour").expect("regenerate contour"),
+    );
+    assert!(
+        cache(&world)
+            .path
+            .notes
+            .iter()
+            .any(|n| n.starts_with("Top below stock:") && n.contains("Z10.000")),
+        "the remote cut did not remove the boss: {:?}",
+        cache(&world).path.notes
+    );
+}

+## #104 - warn when authored Top is below stock
+
+- **Chosen:** For upright 2D/3D milling, diagnose an authored Top below the
+  declared stock over the operation's actual controlled region. Clip stock
+  facets to that region rather than using a remote feature's global height.
+- **Prior cuts:** Reuse the existing lazy same-setup `PriorCell`. Simulate it
+  only when the raw comparison would warn, and read the highest remaining
+  cell over the region, including conservative boundary padding. Only analytic box/
+  cylinder stock receives this credit: a sampled model-stock grid can miss a
+  narrow raised feature, so model-stock history remains unknown for this advisory.
+  An all-nonfinite sampled surface is unknown too. Full local
+  removal to Top clears the warning; partial local removal or unknown history
+  retains it. A local pocket can count without clearing the whole block.
+- **Presentation and compatibility:** Store the advisory in existing path
+  notes with the `Top below stock:` prefix and show it as a warning in the
+  operation status banner. No new serialized verifier variant, project format,
+  dependency, or command is needed. The existing command stores/replays the
+  generated path, including the note, through normal cache and undo handling.
+- **Safety boundary:** Do not add a post blocker or replace any collision
+  verdict. A Top mismatch is not proof that a particular approach collides;
+  the existing move-level checks remain authoritative and still block unsafe
+  paths. Tilted, rotary and turning operations need frame-aware analysis and
+  do not receive this world-Z diagnostic. Drilling retains its existing named
+  R-plane refusal.
+- **Considered and dropped:** Global AABB-only comparison (remote-stock false
+  warnings), a new persisted warning variant (unnecessary format/API churn),
+  early generation refusal (would also reject safe approaches), and treating
+  partial/unknown removal as full clearance (could hide remaining stock).
+- **Cost and limits:** Facet clipping and, only for a raw mismatch with earlier
+  cuts, prior simulation add generation work. Boundary-cell padding may retain
+  conservative warnings near a pocket wall. This is an advisory, not a new
+  safety certification. Extending it to other frames requires their own
+  geometry, not a comparison against world Z. Unit, native integration and UI
+  display/quick-gate checks pin the diagnostic; validation results belong in
+  the PR and issue, not an assertion of success in this decision record.
